name: expansion-e4a
description: Expansion E4A — modular sectional builder (extends the productConfigurator MODULAR_SOFA). Opens the configurator dialog, switches to the Modular sectional tab, and drives per-end options via a slot-label-aware picker (both end slots share option labels, so clickByText is ambiguous — an eval helper finds the .sec by its .sec-h text). Screenshots the live composed preview for: 2-module loveseat, L both ways, 4-module U, 5-module U, 6-module max, plus an orbit profile for joint review.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: install-picker
steps.eval: window.__pickOpt = (slotLabel, optLabel) => { const secs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.configurator-dialog .sec')]; const sec=secs.find(s=>s.querySelector('.sec-h')?.textContent?.trim()===slotLabel); if(!sec) throw new Error('no slot '+slotLabel); const btn=[...sec.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>(b.textContent||'').includes(optLabel)); if(!btn) throw new Error('no opt '+optLabel+' in '+slotLabel); btn.click(); return btn.textContent; }

steps.name: max6-set
steps.eval: window.__pickOpt('Left end','Seat + corner'); window.__pickOpt('Right end','Seat + corner')

steps.name: seatarm-set
steps.eval: window.__pickOpt('Left end','Seat + arm'); window.__pickOpt('Right end','Seat + arm')
